name: aerospace-cheatsheet
title: AeroSpace Cheatsheet
description: Look up, learn, run, and edit your AeroSpace keybindings. Reads your own config, so every key it shows is one you actually have.
author: nmcv

commands.name: cheatsheet
commands.title: AeroSpace Cheatsheet
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Your bindings, grouped and named, with layout diagrams, recipes, and in-place editing

commands.name: goToWorkspace
commands.title: Go to Workspace
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Jump to a workspace, with the apps on each one shown

commands.name: switchApps
commands.title: Switch Windows
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Focus any window across all workspaces

commands.name: showConfig
commands.title: Show AeroSpace Config
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Read the raw aerospace.toml with syntax highlighting

commands.name: moveWindowToWorkspace
commands.title: Move Window to Workspace
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Send the focused window to a workspace, creating it if the name is new

commands.name: bringWorkspaceHere
commands.title: Bring Workspace to This Display
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Pull a workspace onto the display you are looking at

commands.name: reloadConfig
commands.title: Reload AeroSpace Config
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Re-read aerospace.toml, checking it parses first

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: AeroSpace Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: AeroSpace
commands.description: Current workspace and layout actions in the menu bar

preferences.name: aerospacePath
preferences.title: AeroSpace Binary
preferences.description: Path to the aerospace executable. Leave blank unless you installed AeroSpace somewhere other than Homebrew or /Applications.

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: Config File
preferences.description: Path to your aerospace.toml. Leave blank to use the location AeroSpace reports, falling back to ~/.aerospace.toml.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && ray lint
